capabilities: Track cards across several collection lists with finish, condition, language and grading
Build decks with mainboard, sideboard, maybeboard and a Commander slot
Keep wantlists and move acquired cards into the collection
Import and export CSV and plain-text decklists
Recognise a card from a photo and propose printings
extras: Card recognition from a photo is labelled beta and downloads a 10.6 MB artwork index on first use; the plugin file grows to about 6 MB, which Obsidian Sync's Standard plan will not carry. GitHub storage is optional and keeps the token in Obsidian's secret storage. No analytics or telemetry; the README lists every network service and what it is asked for.
problem: Plain notes cannot hold a card collection with per-card finish, condition, language and price, nor deck lists and wantlists that stay current with card data and prices.

relations.evidence: Card data, images and symbols come from Scryfall.
The price history is built from MTGJSON
Card Kingdom column | Card Kingdom's public pricelist
Mana Pool column | Mana Pool's public price list on a computer
Import and export: CSV and plain-text decklists (Moxfield, Archidekt, MTGO, Arena)

summary: Plugin that tracks a physical Magic: The Gathering collection, decks and wantlists, with card data and prices from Scryfall.
